source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: addKeyServer checks an allowed URL prefix, parses input and awaits a host fetch. It does not inspect response status or a keyserver API result. It then stores protocol plus host, deduplicates that string and rerenders. Failure alerts and returns without another prompt. These are URL/connectivity boundaries, not a proved working keyserver or a network result from this study.
title: Adding a keyserver checks connectivity rather than the keyserver protocol
